description: This file defines an ApprovalService for managing submission approvals involving electronic signatures, Segregation of Duties (SoD) checks, and state transitions. It includes custom exceptions, methods for creating e-sign challenges, verifying signatures, approving/rejecting submissions, and retrieving approval records. The service interacts with a database and an audit system, implementing business logic for approval workflows within a project.

classes.name: ApprovalError
classes.description: Base exception class for approval-related errors.

classes.name: SoDViolationError
classes.description: Exception for Segregation of Duties violations.

classes.name: SignatureError
classes.description: Exception for electronic signature validation failures.

classes.name: InvalidStateError
classes.description: Exception for invalid workflow state transitions.

classes.name: ApprovalService
classes.description: Service class implementing approval workflows with signature validation, SoD enforcement, and audit logging.
